reason: I scroll TikTok before bed and sleep is a thing for me, so $24.99 for the first box is an easy impulse add to cart. The lab report on the box is a nice extra, but the price is what gets me to tap.
objection: Two capsules every day is a lot to keep up with, and I know I will probably quit around week two. Also it says made in China, so I only half believe the lab thing.
would_change_my_mind: A creator I follow showing it helping her sleep in a real video, or one capsule instead of two.
